description: This file contains utility functions and data models for handling error responses in an API built with FastAPI. It defines an error response schema, functions to generate standard HTTP exceptions with consistent payloads, and helper functions for common error scenarios like 'not found' and 'bad request'.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: Defines a standardized error response payload for the API, including fields for error code, message, and optional details.

methods.name: HTTPException http_error( *, status_code: int, error: str, message: str, details: dict | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates a standardized HTTPException with an error payload, including status code, error code, message, and optional details.

methods.name: HTTPException not_found(resource: str, resource_id: int)
methods.description: Generates a 404 HTTPException indicating a resource with a specific ID was not found.

methods.name: HTTPException bad_request(message: str, details: dict | None = None)
methods.description: Generates a 400 HTTPException representing a bad request with a custom message and optional details.

ctags.name: bad_request
ctags.pattern: /^def bad_request(message: str, details: dict | None = None) -> HTTPException:$/

ctags.name: error
ctags.pattern: /^    error: str = Field(..., description="Stable error code identifier.")$/

ctags.name: http_error
ctags.signature: ( *, status_code: int, error: str, message: str, details: dict | None = None, )

ctags.name: message
ctags.pattern: /^    message: str = Field(..., description="Human readable description of the error.")$/
